description: External comparison protocol for 3DGS training-time systems. Compares the frozen C0 trainer and its exactness-preserving variants against public baselines (INRIA 3DGS, FastGS, Sparse Adam, gsplat) on a common training recipe. DISTINCT from benchmark/ (the rendering/inference suite); this protocol measures TRAINING cost, quality, and exactness, and never shares a ranking with the rendering track.

common_recipe.optimizer: torch.optim.Adam, betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-15, weight_decay=0, amsgrad=False, DENSE over all rows
common_recipe.loss: 0.8*L1 + 0.2*(1 - fused_ssim), fused = rahul-goel/fused-ssim a7c48d6d padding=same train=True
common_recipe.holdout: true-holdout i % 8 == 0 excluded from training; used ONLY for the holdout quality metric
common_recipe.correctness_reference: frozen C0 dense single-tensor Adam (A_s, foreach=False)

measurement_boundaries.training_time: process_start .. final_checkpoint_saved; fresh process per run; cold start included
measurement_boundaries.iteration_time: CUDA-event mean over the measured window; warmup 100 iters excluded
measurement_boundaries.optimizer_time: CUDA-event time inside optimizer.step() only (excludes forward/backward/densify)
measurement_boundaries.vram: NVML process peak MiB over the whole run
measurement_boundaries.quality: PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS on the 100 ordered canonical cameras; holdout metrics on the i%8==0 split
measurement_boundaries.correctness: state/topology hashes vs the frozen C0 dense reference at iteration 30000

evidence_tiers.measured: produced by this protocol on EPIC-05 A100, raw samples retained
evidence_tiers.reproduced: re-run of a public baseline's official recipe, hash-verified
evidence_tiers.paper_reported: number taken from the baseline's paper; NOT comparable to measured without reproduction

ranking_rules.exactness_gates_are_separate_from_speed: a baseline that fails the correctness gates is marked EXACTNESS_FAIL regardless of speed; it is not ranked against exact methods on speed alone
ranking_rules.no_threshold_relaxation: gates are fixed at protocol authoring time; changing a gate requires a new protocol version

promotion_gates.LAVOS: included as a baseline ONLY if LAVOS0 verdict is LAVOS0_HEADROOM_PROMOTE or LAVOS0_STRONG_HEADROOM_PROMOTE; otherwise listed as NOT_PROMOTED and excluded from ranking
promotion_gates.VTS0: CLOSED (VTS0_DROP, extra_safe_skip_headroom=0.0 < 10%); NOT a baseline; recorded as a closed direction
promotion_gates.DetGS0: positioning only (NO_PUBLIC_COLLISION vs public, occupied by LAVOS0 internally); not a runnable baseline
